goal.what: A person who meets rn decides from the README whether to use it, starts by its steps alone, and knows where to read next.

decisions.what: rn takes a piece of work asked in rough words to a pull request that meets your purpose, asking only what is yours.
Idea against Claude Code alone: each point asked first; the purpose as goal and criteria every task serves; a short record carried from move to move; turn makes and has each work used in your place.
Non-goals: no merge, no push to the default branch, nothing sent unasked, its own checklists untouched.
Walkthrough: UX O1 on the TypeScript move: one point, the goal sign-off, the deliverable sign-off, ready.
How it works: the figure; under it only who talks with you and where an approval is taken from.
